title: Current servicer loyalty plus "call me next month"
scenario: Friendly mechanic whose current lender has offered him a streamline refinance says he will probably stick with them and asks to be called next month. Rep respects it and stays compliant.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi, is this Lucho? This is Annika with Copperleaf Home Loans.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Hey, yeah, this is Lucho. How you doing?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Doing well, thanks! How about you?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Can't complain. Covered in grease, but can't complain, ha.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, sounds like a good honest day. You'd asked about refinancing?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, I did, but my current lender just sent me a letter saying they can do a streamline. I'll probably just stay with them, it seems easier.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a reasonable option to consider. Is your current loan FHA?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, FHA. Bought about three years ago.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. Did their letter mention any costs or a new rate?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Not really, just said I could lower my payment.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: It's worth getting their offer in writing so you can see the full picture. And if you'd like, I can put together an estimate so you have something to compare.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Maybe. Honestly, call me next month. Things are hectic at the shop right now.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: No problem at all. Any particular week?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Early December's good.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: How about Tuesday, December second, around lunch?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, December second works.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Great. In the meantime, if their offer comes through, keep it handy and we can look at it together.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Will do. Though like I said, I'll probably just go with them.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally fair. Either way, you'll make a more informed decision.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Sounds good. Thanks, Annika.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Talk soon, Lucho.
